Kenya 7-day outlook

Also see the Open-Meteo 7-day dashboard or the animated version.

Tap or click anywhere on the map to see the exact amount for that spot.

The map shows KMD’s forecast grid, with points about 4 km apart. County and ward figures are the average of all grid points inside each area; the wettest, hottest or coldest point is the most extreme grid value inside it.

Lakes are shown in blue and are left out of county and ward figures, so those describe the land. Dew point shows how much moisture is in the air: above about 20 °C feels muggy. Air pressure is adjusted to sea level; low pressure often comes with unsettled weather. Wind is measured 10 m above the ground. Sunshine is the sunlight reaching the ground in watts per square metre, soil moisture the share of water in the top soil layer, cloud cover the share of the sky covered by cloud, and humidity the relative humidity near the ground. Each measure appears when KMD’s file includes it.
